products.name: CXIQ
products.tagline: Every conversation handled. Every dollar approved.
products.body: An AI layer on top of the WhatsApp and email you already use — no migration — that answers routine questions automatically, and always puts a human in the loop the moment a conversation touches money.

features.label: Conversational AI
features.desc: Bedrock + Lex v2 answer routine questions on WhatsApp and email.

features.label: Approval-gated
features.desc: Every money action routes to a human before it moves.

features.label: Voice escalation
features.desc: Complex queries hand off to Amazon Connect with full context.

products.name: DocIQ
products.body: A cost-tiered AI pipeline on AWS that replaces manual document keying with confidence-routed extraction — cutting document processing cost by up to 97%, hosted entirely in your own region.

features.label: Textract → Bedrock
features.desc: Cheapest tier that meets the accuracy bar, escalating only when needed.

features.label: Human boundary
features.desc: Below-threshold documents always route to a reviewer.

features.label: ERP delivery
features.desc: HMAC-signed webhook into SAP, Oracle, or NetSuite.

products.name: OpsIQ
products.body: An agentic AIOps layer on Amazon Bedrock that classifies, resolves, and closes the majority of L1 service-desk tickets directly in your existing ITSM platform — with every Active Directory, firewall, or bulk-impact action gated behind a human decision.

features.label: 3-tier autonomy
features.desc: Tier 1/2 resolve automatically; Tier 3 pauses for approval.

features.label: No domain-admin
features.desc: A scoped service account only — least privilege throughout.

features.label: Auto-rollback
features.desc: Multi-step runbooks roll back automatically on failure.

products.name: PayIQ
products.body: AI reads every invoice and posts the ones it's confident about straight into Xero or Zoho Books. The rest come to you for a one-click review. And the moment a vendor's bank details change, PayIQ always stops and asks a human first.

features.label: Touchless posting
features.desc: Confident invoices post straight into Xero or Zoho Books.

features.label: Fraud hard-stop
features.desc: A vendor bank-detail change always requires human sign-off.

features.label: Xero + Zoho
features.desc: Both connectors live from day one.

products.name: GenAI Operations Automation
products.tagline: Less manual work. More finished work.
products.body: An AWS-native platform that automates the end-to-end document lifecycle across finance, HR, and operations — built for Singapore with UEN validation, GST checks, and PayNow matching, all inside your own AWS account.

features.label: Document processing
features.desc: Invoices, claims, and POs extracted with Singapore UEN & GST validation.

features.label: AR/AP reconciliation
features.desc: AI GL coding and bank matching posted to Xero, QuickBooks, SAP.

features.label: Conversational assistant
features.desc: Natural-language queries over finance, HR, and ops — with cited answers.

moreProducts.name: Algokisan
moreProducts.tagline: A direct line from farm to buyer.
moreProducts.body: Farmers list their produce. Buyers reach out directly — no middlemen, no markup. When either side needs it, transport is built right into the app.

features.label: Direct listings
features.desc: Farmers post produce with photos, quantity, and asking price.

features.label: Buyer ↔ seller chat
features.desc: Negotiate and confirm orders inside the app.

features.label: Optional transport
features.desc: Either party can request in-app transport for the load.

moreProducts.name: Algoride
moreProducts.body: Carpool with people heading the same way, or hire a full vehicle and driver for the trip. Built for the long haul between cities — not for hopping across town.

modes.title: Carpooling
modes.desc: Intercity rides only — riders match with drivers going the same route. Not designed for intra-city trips.

modes.title: For-Hire
modes.desc: Hire a vehicle along with its driver for a planned trip. Owners can publish their vehicles to earn.

moreProducts.name: Algomart
moreProducts.body: We're not ready to talk about this one yet — but it's moving fast and it's almost here. Drop your email and we'll tell you the moment it lands.
